name: Louis Mercuris
source:
Favorite thing: Dorayaki, Fried Prawn
Hobby: Collecting masks

Carol's older sister, and one of bridal candidate for Yukito. She obtained the title of "Genius Witch", after just a year since her graduation from academy. She also good at handling household work. Her abilities make her the strongest candidate for marriage.
